mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced corporate revenues.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST < 1080 and RSAFS < 450000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 238.0 signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 238.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a dual shock of labor market weakness and monetary tightening, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 0.35%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing growth that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during early-cycle expansion when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
